_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this plugin's hook rules. Consumed by hook-engine.sh (enforce), gen-hooks-doc.sh (docs), test-hooks.sh (fixtures). NEVER hand-edit deployed copy — edit here + build.sh switch.

rules.reason: Memory structure rule: MEMORY.md is an index, not a preload bundle. CC auto-loads MEMORY.md plus any .md under SUBDIRECTORIES of the memory dir (loose files beside MEMORY.md are not loaded) — so entries live in a sibling memory-entries/ dir, outside memory/. Measured 2026-07-30: a subfolder reorg inside memory/ blew preload from ~4.5k to ~87k tokens.
